entries.contact: Michael Berg, Partner and Talent Buyer, North Coast Music Festival / Collectiv Presents
entries.subject: For Michael Berg: Habeeb / North Coast 2027
entries.action: Send first through North Coast's published general inbox and ask that it be routed to Michael Berg. Confirm the 2027 dates and the most suitable house or UK-garage-leaning stage before discussing terms.
entries.fit: Strong U.S. fit: the 2026 bill paired house with UK garage and bassline-adjacent programming. The recipient is a general festival inbox, not Michael's personal address.
entries.body:
Hi Michael,

North Coast's 2026 bookings of Chris Lorenzo and Sammy Virji are why I'm reaching out about Habeeb for 2027. That space between House, Tech House and UK garage is a natural fit for his sound.

I'm Joanna Biehler, his manager at Night Method Agency. Habeeb is a House / Tech House artist with an experimental edge, and he builds his sets as dynamic performances rather than a fixed run of club records. He has played Breakaway Dallas 2026 and Breakaway Houston 2026, and he has opened for James Kennedy and Benjamin Lloyd.

You can hear his music and see the live context in the [Habeeb EPK](https://nightmethodagency.com/habeeb).

Would you consider him for North Coast 2027, particularly where the programme leans into house or UK club sounds? If this reaches the general team, please route it to Michael or the festival's talent buyers.

Best,
Joanna Biehler
Night Method Agency

entries.body:
Hi Farhad,

I'm reaching out about Habeeb for VELD 2027. Fisher and Mau P on the 2026 bill show the kind of direct, high-energy house programming where his work makes sense.

I'm Joanna Biehler, Habeeb's manager at Night Method Agency. He is a House / Tech House artist with an experimental edge, and his sets are dynamic performances built for a festival crowd. He has played Breakaway Dallas 2026 and Breakaway Houston 2026, and he has opened for James Kennedy and Benjamin Lloyd. Those rooms have sharpened a set that can move quickly without losing its club foundation.

His music and performance background are in the [Habeeb EPK](https://nightmethodagency.com/habeeb).

Would you consider Habeeb for VELD 2027? If the fit is there, I'd be glad to discuss availability, travel and the right stage context. If this lands with the general team, please forward it to Farhad or VELD talent programming.

Best,
Joanna Biehler
Night Method Agency

entries.fit: Credible but selective: Awakenings is techno-led, while its 2026 Area B programming created a house and tech-house bridge. The inbox is general routing.
entries.body:
Hi Tim,

Awakenings is a selective ask, but the 2026 Area B bookings of Sidney Charles and Cloonee give me a clear reason to introduce Habeeb for 2027. His sound sits on the House / Tech House side of that programme, with an experimental edge.

I'm Joanna Biehler, his manager at Night Method Agency. Habeeb treats his sets as dynamic performances, building tension and movement instead of relying on a single tempo or formula. He has played Breakaway Dallas 2026 and Breakaway Houston 2026, and he has opened for James Kennedy and Benjamin Lloyd.

You can hear the music and see his background in the [Habeeb EPK](https://nightmethodagency.com/habeeb).

Would you consider him for Awakenings Festival 2027 where the curation moves toward house and tech house? If this reaches the general team, please route it to Tim or the artists and bookings team. I'm happy to discuss availability and travel if the music fits.

Best,
Joanna Biehler
Night Method Agency
